forgot_password.title: Forgot Your Password?
forgot_password.subtitle: No problem. Enter your email address below and we'll send you a link to reset it.
forgot_password.success_desc1: We've sent an email to your registered email address with instructions on how to reset your password. Please check your inbox and follow the steps provided.
forgot_password.success_desc2: If you don't see the email in your inbox, please check your spam or junk folder. It may take a few minutes for the email to arrive.
forgot_password.support_text: If you continue to experience issues, please contact our support team at
forgot_password.thanks: Thank you for using our platform!
forgot_password.error_desc1: We encountered an error while attempting to send the password reset email to your registered email address.
forgot_password.error_desc2: Please ensure that the email address provided is correct and try again. If the problem persists, please contact our support team at
forgot_password.apology: We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

reset_password.invalid_link_desc2: Please request a new password reset link by visiting the forgot password page and submitting your email address again. Make sure to use the latest link sent to your email inbox.
reset_password.support_text: If you continue to experience issues, please contact our support team at
reset_password.apology: We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
